definitions.false_positive_loss_fraction: Wrong or unmatched predicted LOSS / all predicted LOSS
definitions.false_positive_loss_rate: Annotated WIN incorrectly classified LOSS / all annotated WIN
definitions.win_loss_accuracy: Correct result / matched games; UNKNOWN counts as incorrect
definitions.matched_games: Legacy metric: all available boundaries match; incomplete predictions can match
definitions.complete_game_detection_recall: Both start and end within tolerance / all annotated games
definitions.partial_game_reconstruction_recall: Unmatched annotated games with a matched partial prediction / all annotated games; complete matches reserved first
definitions.any_game_reconstruction_recall: Disjoint complete plus partial matches / all annotated games
definitions.game_result_classification_accuracy: Correct assembled result / end-anchor matched games, independent of start; UNKNOWN incorrect
definitions.complete_loss_recall: Correct LOSS with both matched boundaries / all annotated LOSS
definitions.complete_loss_precision: Correct LOSS with both matched boundaries / complete predicted LOSS
definitions.result_detection_recall: Result anchor observed within tolerance, independent of VICTORY/DEFEAT label
definitions.victory_recall: Correctly classified VICTORY anchors / annotated WIN results
definitions.defeat_recall: Correctly classified DEFEAT anchors / annotated LOSS results
definitions.false_positive_event_count: Unmatched temporal anchors; classified errors are separately visible per class
definitions.result_timestamp_error: Absolute timestamp errors of pooled result-anchor matches, independent of classification
